title: 第四章 圣女养成第五章 再添信徒
lines: 吴辉的一抹意识依附在银色十字架上，顿时敏锐地感觉到了凯瑟琳娜的想法，心中不由满意。果然是个聪明的妹子，这样，他赐福起来也放心一些，起码不用担心自己的神力会打水漂。
其实，他并非不能直接用神力把那几个帝国士兵干掉。
别看他现在只剩下0.9点神力，但蚊子腿再小，那也是神力。只要吴辉愿意动用其中一小部分，那几个弱小的帝国士兵立马就会一命呜呼。
但吴辉并不准备这么干。
这么干虽然简单粗暴，可性价比着实太低了。
他现在急需的是一位可以替他稳定，并传播信仰的代言人。而不是单纯的多一两个信徒。好不容易降临了一次，又有现成的合适人选，他当然要优先把神力花在自己准备培养的代言人身上。
虽说凯瑟琳娜的潜质还不足以担当圣女，实力也远远不够，但这没关系，只要有神力在，就能提升她的实力等级。
更何况，吴辉现在也没得选择。如果不能扶持出一位代言人，迎接他这位光明神的，便是彻底的毁灭。
神力无所不能，同样也能提升一个人的潜质，只不过生灵的潜质和灵魂强度有关。而灵魂强度，又和生命本源戚戚相关，提升起来极为耗费神力，可不是眼下能玩得转的。
当然，他现在神力匮乏，谨慎起见，还是只能一点点尝试提升她的实力。
他把体内剩下的0.9点神力分成了九股，每次只输出一股，一点点地输入凯瑟琳娜体内，尝试着提升她的实力。
一股……
当第一股神力涌入凯瑟琳娜体内的那一瞬间，凯瑟琳娜浑身一震，仿佛有一道无形的桎梏被瞬间打破。
刹那间。
一道纯净无暇的白光骤然从天而降，兜头将凯瑟琳娜笼罩在了其中。
强大的力量洗涤着她的身体，骨骼，甚至是灵魂，她本就姣好的脸上瞬间蒙上了一层圣光，眼神渐渐变得深邃，就连通体的气质也在这一瞬间变得无比圣洁。
说时迟那时快。
所有的变化都仿佛是在眨眼之间发生，就在这一瞬间，神格显示的信息之中，凯瑟琳娜的等级从“0级”一下跳到了“1级”。
吴辉心中一喜，光是0.1的神力，就让凯瑟琳娜修为实力提升了一大截。可见神力真是强大，哪怕是仅有1点神力，也是一笔巨大的财富。
他不再犹豫当即下达了第二道指令：“神格，继续提高凯瑟琳娜的实力等级。”
话音刚落，以0.1点为单位的神力，一点点涌入了凯瑟琳娜体内。
但是这一次，总计耗费了0.2点神力，才起到了效果。
凯瑟琳娜身上的白色光芒蓦然大盛，威严浩瀚的神力化为有如实质的强大力量，让她体内的每一个细胞都在顷刻间完成了蜕变。
刹那间，一股更加强大的气息从她身上升腾而起。
神格显示的信息中，凯瑟琳娜的职业等级也在同一时间变成了2级。
2级了！
短短一瞬间，凯瑟琳娜就达到了2级。
不过，2级的实力，也就能勉强应付一下眼前的场面。
但是还不够。
再来！
吴辉一狠心，再次输出了神力，这一次耗费到0.4点神力。
刹那间，凯瑟琳娜的气息再度拔升，实力也在眨眼间变成了3级。
content_en:
…
Wu Hui's consciousness was attached to the silver cross, and he suddenly felt Katherina's thoughts keenly, and he couldn't help but feel satisfied. She is indeed a smart girl. In this way, he feels more at ease when blessing her. At least he doesn't have to worry about his magical power being in vain.
In fact, it was not that he couldn't directly use his divine power to kill those imperial soldiers.
Even though he only has 0.9 points of divine power left now, no matter how small his mosquito legs are, he still has divine power. As long as Wu Hui is willing to use a small part of them, those few weak imperial soldiers will die immediately.
But Wu Hui was not prepared to do this.
Although this is simple and crude, the cost-effectiveness is really low.
What he urgently needs now is a spokesperson who can stabilize him and spread his faith. Rather than simply having one or two more believers. It finally happened once, and there was a suitable candidate ready-made. Of course, he had to give priority to spending his power on the spokesperson he planned to cultivate.
Although Katherina's potential is not enough to be a saint, and her strength is far from enough, it doesn't matter. As long as she has divine power, her strength level can be improved.
What's more, Wu Hui has no choice now. If we cannot support a spokesperson, welcoming him, the God of Light, will be complete destruction.
Divine power is omnipotent and can also improve a person's potential, but the potential of a creature is related to the strength of the soul. The strength of the soul is closely related to the origin of life. It takes a lot of divine power to increase it, which is not something that can be played right now.
Of course, he currently lacks divine power, so to be cautious, he can only try to improve her strength little by little.
He divided the remaining 0.9 points of divine power in his body into nine strands, outputting only one strand at a time, and inputting it into Katherina's body bit by bit, trying to improve her strength.
One share...
The moment the first wave of divine power poured into Katherina's body, Katherina was shocked, as if an invisible shackles were instantly broken.
In an instant.
A pure white light suddenly fell from the sky, and Dou Tou enveloped Katherina in it.
The powerful power washed her body, bones, and even soul. Her already beautiful face was instantly covered with a layer of holy light, her eyes gradually became deeper, and even her temperament became extremely holy at this moment.
It's too late, it's fast.
All the changes seemed to happen in the blink of an eye. At this moment, in the information displayed by the Godhead, Katharina's level jumped from "Level 0" to "Level 1".
Wu Hui was overjoyed. Just 0.1 of her divine power had greatly improved Katharina's cultivation strength. It can be seen that divine power is really powerful. Even if it has only 1 point of divine power, it is still a huge wealth.
He no longer hesitated and immediately issued the second order: "Godhead, continue to improve Katharina's strength level."
As soon as she finished speaking, divine power in units of 0.1 points poured into Katharina's body bit by bit.
But this time, it took a total of 0.2 points of divine power to achieve the effect.
The white light on Katharina's body suddenly flourished, and the majestic and vast divine power turned into a powerful force that was as substantial as reality, causing every cell in her body to complete transformation in an instant.
In an instant, a more powerful aura rose from her body.
In the information displayed by the godhead, Katherina's professional level also changed to level 2 at the same time.
Level 2!
In just a short moment, Katharina reached level 2.
However, with level 2 strength, he could barely cope with the scene in front of him.
But it's not enough.
Come again!
Wu Hui was cruel and output his divine power again, this time consuming 0.4 points of divine power.
In an instant, Katherina's aura increased again, and her strength also reached level 3 in the blink of an eye.
title_en: Chapter 4: The Development of a Saint Chapter 5: Adding New Believers
